With the problem-text connection (shunt terminals on the primary side, series terminals on the secondary side), this is a step-up connection. So the self-capacity is the series-winding voltage (V₂−V₁) × series-winding current I₂ = (V₂−V₁)I₂, and the candidate's step-up assumption agrees with the problem text. Secondary terminal voltage × secondary current V₂I₂ = load capacity (線路容量/通過容量), so (ウ)=負荷容量. Because part of the winding is shared, leakage flux is small, so leakage reactance is small and voltage regulation is small: (エ)=少なく, (オ)=小さい. The causal chain is correct.
